ruleset.name: CommandsSpy test sources
ruleset.description: Same categories as the main sources (errorprone + bestpractices), minus the two PMD unit-test style rules that no real suite can satisfy: UnitTestContainsTooManyAsserts caps a test at ONE assertion, and UnitTestAssertionsShouldIncludeMessage demands a message on every assertion. Everything else - including UselessPureMethodCall, AvoidDuplicateLiterals and the real correctness rules - still applies to test code.
